test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which type of system did the leaders of independent India decide to adopt?

options.text: A system that would promote the welfare of all rather than a few
A system that would promote the welfare of the government
A system that would promote the welfare of private enterprises
A system that would promote the welfare of few rather than all

solution:
The correct answer is __**A system that would promote the welfare of all rather than a few**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The leaders of independent India decided to adopt **a system that would promote the welfare of all rather than a few**.
 
• This decision was rooted in the values of **democracy, equality, and social justice**.
